mentions.h: A dominating win in the semi
Close ! But Belgrave are Cup Winners again
mentions.note: Golden Jubilee Cup results box: semi-final 1500m 1st 4:31.2 (printed 4.31.2); final 800m 5th 2:13.45, 1500m 5th 4:37.76

photos.c: Bottom right: One of Belgrave's growing band of middle distance runners, Julie Mitchell twice broke the club record for 1500m (although that record is now owned by Catherine Berry). Julie placed 2nd in the Golden Jubilee Cup Final 1500m.

photo.caption: Bottom right: One of Belgrave's growing band of middle distance runners, Julie Mitchell twice broke the club record for 1500m (although that record is now owned by Catherine Berry). Julie placed 2nd in the Golden Jubilee Cup Final 1500m.
